title: Display shared discussions
responsibility: Convert shared threads and comments into desktop display records.

inputs.name: hubMessages.thread
inputs.description: Committed thread whose comments should be displayed.

outputs.name: hubThreads
outputs.description: Thread summaries sorted by ID, with sequential pins starting at offset plus one, image anchors and comment counts.

outputs.name: hubMessages
outputs.description: Comments in supplied order as user messages, retaining author identity/name, timestamp, text and version/image anchor; agent mode/provider/model are null.
